articles.title: Federal Reserve proposes limited master accounts long pursued by crypto firms
articles.snippet: The U.S. Fed issued a revised proposal on the structure of payment accounts, taking the next step to build on an earlier pitch for so-called skinny accounts.

articles.title: SpaceX reveals larger-than-expected Bitcoin holdings in IPO filing
articles.snippet: SpaceX is expected to go public next month, which would make its 18,712 Bitcoin holdings rank seventh among public companies.

articles.title: Crypto Wealth Firm Nexo Sponsors $3 Million Golf Tournament at Trump International Scotland
articles.snippet: Trump International Golf Links will again host the DP World Tour's Nexo Championship, now with a $3 million prize pool.
